trigger.T_tech_outflow: XLK creations/redemptions summed over 28 calendar days < 0
trigger.E_btc_etf_inflow: US spot BTC ETF net flows summed over 28 calendar days > 0
trigger.P_premium_positive: Coinbase premium, USDT-adjusted (Coinbase BTC-USD / (Binance BTC-USDT x Coinbase USDT-USD) - 1), 30-day average > 0; raw (unadjusted) before Apr 2021
trigger.score: T + E + P; 3 ON, 2 Building, 1 Early, 0 Off; evaluated weekly (Fri) and on the latest day

gaps: Tech flows are a ONE-ETF proxy (XLK, ~$117B). Not EPFR/LSEG or ICI tech-fund totals; QQQ/SMH/SOXX/VGT histories were not free.
BTC ETF flows start Jan 11 2024, so the full 3-part score exists only from Feb 2024 (the backtest is short).
Premium uses daily UTC closes, not Glassnode's hourly method. Signal uses the USDT-adjusted premium (Apr 2021+); raw premium (Glassnode-style) is also published.
